messages:
jamie: Heads-up — starting a config-only deploy in ~10m to tweak timeouts/limits for the model routing experiment. No binary changes. Main changes: request_timeout -> 1.2s, per_route_qps cap 120, batch_window_ms -> 6ms. Canary will be pinned to model v2.3.0 for 5% traffic. I'll post the exact rollout plan in a sec.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by jamie. Change set: config-only routing+batching. Canary target: route=fast-text, model_pin=v2.3.0, percentage=5. ETA start=2140098775.

sasha: thanks. quick question — does the config respect drain behavior for in-flight KV cache? we saw tail latency when we reduced batch_window last time.

jamie: yes — added drain_grace_s: 60 to the route so existing connections finish. That should avoid mid-request errors. Also enabling prefix_kv_cache:true for canary only.

leo: can we add an explicit fallback policy if canary backend starts rejecting? prefer fallback to v2.2.1 (quantized) rather than full rollback. config snippet I propose:

```
route: fast-text
  model_pin: v2.3.0
  fallback:
    on_error: route_to_model
    model: v2.2.1
  limits:
    per_route_qps: 120
    request_timeout_ms: 1200
  batching:
    batch_window_ms: 6
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
```

maria: i'm +1 on fallback. but please hold the canary start until we confirm overnight traffic pattern is stable — ops asked for a quiet-window check at 02:00 UTC. can we schedule canary for 03:00 UTC instead?

jamie: ok moving to 03:00 UTC. updated deploy-bot. also will do step ramp 5% -> 25% -> 50% with 10m hold each. rollback plan: `rctl rollback-config --route fast-text --to previous` + pin back v2.2.1.

deploy-bot: Updated schedule: start=2140109400 (03:00 UTC), steps=[5,25,50], hold=600s each. Change set still config-only.

ops-bot: FYI alert rule: latency_p95 > 900ms for route fast-text will trigger pager. current baseline p95=420ms.

jamie: noted. will keep an eye during canary. If p95 spikes > 900ms during a hold, we auto-fallback to v2.2.1 (as leo suggested) and pause rollout.

devex: small nit — SDK clients that set per-request timeout < 1.2s will still get client-side timeout. Might want to add a note in release notes so partners don't see early disconnects.

maria: also record the batching experiment ID in the changelog: batching-expt-2026-03. needed for eval/quality tracking.

jamie: adding to release notes: "config-only: routing limits/timeouts/batching params; canary pinned v2.3.0; fallback -> v2.2.1; drain_grace_s=60; batching-expt-2026-03".

[2140109405] deploy-bot: Canary 5% started on route=fast-text, model=v2.3.0.

[2140109465] ops-bot: Metric snapshot at +1m: p95=460ms, qps=38, error_rate=0.01. No anomalies.

[2140109985] ops-bot: Metric snapshot at +10m: p95=880ms, qps=120, error_rate=0.03. Approaching p95 alert threshold.

leo: i'm seeing queuing backpressure on one pool, suggests batch_window=6ms is causing slightly larger batches under burst QPS. propose lowering to 4ms for canary to reduce queuing.

jamie: acknowledge. moving batch_window_ms to 4ms for canary only. issuing quick patch. command: `rdeploy set-config fast-text --batch_window_ms=4 --canary-only`

[2140109992] deploy-bot: Config patch applied for canary. batch_window_ms=4ms.

[2140110045] ops-bot: Post-patch snapshot at +2m: p95=520ms, qps=118, error_rate=0.015. Good improvement.

maria: looks safe. continue ramp.

[2140110645] deploy-bot: Rolling to 25% now.

sasha: monitoring traces — KV cache hit-rate improved slightly with prefix_kv_cache:true. no obvious correctness regressions in outputs.

[2140111245] deploy-bot: Rolling to 50% complete.

jamie: full rollout paused at 50% for 30m extended hold per ops request. collecting perf and quality metrics.

[2140113045] ops-bot: End of extended hold: p95=470ms, qps=310, error_rate=0.018. No pager.

jamie: proceeding to 100% now. final note: release_notes link: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/config-2026-03-batching-expt. please add postmortem if any regressions surface. :thumbsup:

[2140113100] deploy-bot: Config-only deploy complete: route=fast-text now at model=v2.3.0, batch_window_ms=4, per_route_qps=120, request_timeout_ms=1200.

maria: great run. can someone file the follow-up ticket to evaluate tail-latency at 24h and compare to baseline?

jamie: I'll create ticket TKT-4721 and link eval results. closing thread.
